```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r Generate Landscapes}
num_roosts <- 100

# Spatial clustering parameters
cluster_range <- c(1,round(num_roosts/4))
cluster_res <- 3
cluster_seq <- seq(
  cluster_range[1],
  cluster_range[2],
  by=cluster_res
)
sd_range <- c(0.03, 0.2)
sd_seq <- seq(sd_range[1], sd_range[2], length=length(cluster_seq))

landscape_set <- generate_landscapes(
  n_per_bin = 5,
  R_breaks = c(0, 0.4, 0.8, 1.2),
  prop_modern_values = seq(0, 1, by = 0.25),
  num_roosts = num_roosts,
  cluster_values = cluster_seq,
  sd_values = sd_seq
)

# Number of landscape scenarios
design <- landscape_set$design
n_sims <- nrow(design)
n_sims
```

```{r Simulations}
# Storage for simulation results
simulation_results <- vector("list", n_sims)

# Reproducibility
set.seed(123)

# Create progress bar
pb <- progress_bar$new(
  format = " Simulating landscapes [:bar] :percent | ETA: :eta",
  total = n_sims,
  clear = FALSE,
  width = 60
)

for (i in seq_len(n_sims)) {
  
  # Extract landscape
  roost_info <- design$roost_info[[i]]
  
  # Initialize bat populations
  roost_info <- initialize_roost_populations(
    roost_info,
    initial_occupancy = 0.25
  )
  
  # Run epidemic simulation
  simulation_results[[i]] <- run_simulation(
    roost_info = roost_info,
    n_days = 150,
    beta = 0.5,
    gamma = 0.2,
    model = "SIR",
    infection_day = 30,
    initial_infected = 5,
    movement_params = list(
      lambda = 5,
      alpha = 1,
      stay_prob = 0.75,
      epsilon = 0.01
    )
  )
  
  # Attach landscape information
  simulation_results[[i]]$landscape_info <- list(
    simulation_id = i,
    landscape_id = design$landscape_id[i],
    prop_modern = design$prop_modern[i],
    Clark_Evans_R = design$Clark_Evans_R[i],
    num_clusters = design$num_clusters[i],
    sd = design$sd[i],
    R_bin = design$R_bin[i]
  )
  
  pb$tick()
}

names(simulation_results) <- paste0(
  "simulation_",
  seq_len(n_sims)
)
```

```{r Extract Metrics}
extract_epidemic_metrics <- function(simulation) {

  history <- simulation$roost_history

  daily <- do.call(
    rbind,
    lapply(seq_along(history), function(i) {

      roosts <- history[[i]]

      data.frame(
        day = i - 1,
        S = sum(roosts$S),
        I = sum(roosts$I),
        R = sum(roosts$R),
        N = sum(roosts$N)
      )
    })
  )

  peak_day <- which.max(daily$I)

  # Days with at least one infected bat
  infected_days <- daily$day[daily$I > 0]

  data.frame(
    peak_infected = max(daily$I),
    peak_prevalence = max(daily$I / daily$N),
    time_to_peak = daily$day[peak_day],
    infected_bat_days = sum(daily$I),
    epidemic_duration = if (length(infected_days) > 0) {
      max(infected_days) - min(infected_days) + 1
    } else {
      0
    }
  )
}

epidemic_summary <- do.call(
  rbind,
  lapply(seq_along(simulation_results), function(i) {

    metrics <- extract_epidemic_metrics(
      simulation_results[[i]]
    )

    landscape <- simulation_results[[i]]$landscape_info

    data.frame(
      simulation_id = landscape$simulation_id,
      landscape_id = landscape$landscape_id,
      prop_modern = landscape$prop_modern,
      Clark_Evans_R = landscape$Clark_Evans_R,
      num_clusters = landscape$num_clusters,
      sd = landscape$sd,
      metrics
    )
  })
)

head(epidemic_summary)

library(lme4)

model_mixed <- lmer(
  peak_prevalence ~ prop_modern * Clark_Evans_R +
    (1 | landscape_id),
  data = epidemic_summary
)

summary(model_mixed)

```

```{r Plots}
library(ggplot2)

ggplot(
  epidemic_summary,
  aes(
    x = prop_modern,
    y = peak_prevalence,
    color = Clark_Evans_R
  )
) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_color_viridis_c() +
  labs(
    title = "Peak epidemic prevalence across landscapes",
    x = "Proportion modern",
    y = "Peak prevalence",
    color = "Clark-Evans R"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

ggplot(
  epidemic_summary,
  aes(
    x = prop_modern,
    y = time_to_peak,
    color = Clark_Evans_R
  )
) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_color_viridis_c() +
  labs(
    title = "Time to peak infection",
    x = "Proportion modern",
    y = "Days until peak",
    color = "Clark-Evans R"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()



ggplot(
  epidemic_summary,
  aes(
    x = prop_modern,
    y = Clark_Evans_R,
    color = infected_bat_days
  )
) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_color_viridis_c() +
  theme_minimal()

```

```{r Movement plots}
design <- landscape_set$design

selected_design <- design %>%
  filter(prop_modern %in% c(0, 0.5, 1)) %>%
  filter(landscape_id == unique(design$landscape_id)[2])

landscape_df <- selected_design %>%
  select(prop_modern, roost_info) %>%
  tidyr::unnest(roost_info)

ggplot(
  landscape_df,
  aes(x = x, y = y, color = roost_type)
) +
  geom_point(size = 3.5) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~ prop_modern,
    nrow = 1,
    labeller = label_both
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      traditional = "#D69E36",
      modern = "#2878B5"
    )
  ) +
  coord_equal() +
  labs(
    title = "Landscape configurations",
    subtitle = "Effect of building modernization on roost composition",
    x = "X coordinate",
    y = "Y coordinate",
    color = "Building type"
  )

extract_roost_occupancy <- function(simulation) {

  bind_rows(
    lapply(seq_along(simulation$roost_history), function(day) {

      roosts <- simulation$roost_history[[day]]

      roosts %>%
        transmute(
          day = day - 1,
          roost_id,
          N,
          N_max,
          roost_type
        )
    })
  )
}

selected_results <- simulation_results[
  vapply(
    simulation_results,
    function(x) x$landscape_info$landscape_id ==
      unique(selected_design$landscape_id)[1] &&
      x$landscape_info$prop_modern %in% c(0, 0.5, 1),
    logical(1)
  )
]

occupancy_df <- bind_rows(
  lapply(selected_results, function(sim) {

    extract_roost_occupancy(sim) %>%
      mutate(
        prop_modern = sim$landscape_info$prop_modern
      )
  })
)

ggplot(
  occupancy_df,
  aes(
    x = day,
    y = N,
    group = roost_id,
    color = roost_type
  )
) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.7, linewidth = 0.5) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~ prop_modern,
    nrow = 1,
    labeller = label_both
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      traditional = "#D69E36",
      modern = "#2878B5"
    )
  ) + 
  labs(
    title = "Roost occupancy throughout the simulation",
    x = "Simulation day",
    y = "Number of bats",
    color = "Building type"
  )
```
